cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 says an address register or digital addressing system is in service; the 2021 Kampala city address model is outside the window.
cells.note: Kampala was numbering houses in February 2025 (UGA-004), and in October 2026 the communications regulator sought UPU help for a National Addressing System still to be built (UGA-005). Nothing in the window says a register is in service.
